paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
heading: Muvanlaite Leh Grepgui Gentehna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah thuhaksa bawlkhia inla, gentehna in gen in,
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, chi in; Muvanlai lianpi, kha zapi, khaveng saupi gial em-um, mul bittak Lebanon tang ah aleng a, sidar sing zik atuah hi.
Ahiang ziknou pen akitan a, mi vialvakna gam ah alenpih a, sumsinna khopi ah aphut hi.
Huai gam haichi leng atuah a, lei hoih ah apawipou a, tui tampi gei ah aphut a, muisum sing bang in aphut hi.
Huan akhang a, grepgui niam bilbial ahong hi a, selnoute ahon suah a, ahiangte ahong dawn hi.

"Muvanlai lianpi dang a-om nawn a, kha zapi leh mul bittak anei a, ngai in, hiai grep kung amah lam ah azung azam a; asuanna mun a kipan in amah lam ah hiangte apoukhia a, amah tui a avaktheihna ding in.
Hiangte asuah a, grep hoihtak ahihtheihna ding in tui tampi gei a lei hoih aphuh ahi."

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Apiching den dia hia? Avuai maimah theihna ding in anahte satkhia in, azung toh abotkhe kei dia hia? Anah sel thak tengteng in leng avuailoh ding; azung toh botkhe ding in thilhihtheihna thupitak hiam, muvanlai tampi akiphamoh tuan kei dia hia?
"Ahi, ngai in, phuh hileh leng apiching den dia hia? Suahlam huih in ahon nuai hun chiang in avuai khin maimah kei dia hia? Apouna mun mah ah avuai maimah ding chi in," achi a.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
heading: Gentehna Hilhchetna

paite: "Helhat inkote kiang ah gen in, hiai thil omdan athei kei ua hia? Hilh in, ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Jerusalem ah ahong pai a,
akumpipa uleh aheutu uh aman a, amah kiang ah Babulon ah api a, akumpipa uh suan khat aman a, thukhun abawlpih a, thu achiam teitei a, gam a miliante apimang vek a,
alalna gam akeniam a, amah a adinkhiak theih nawnlouhna ding in athukhun len kawm kia a adintheihna ding in.

Himahleh sakolte leh mi tampi hon sawl ding a ngen ding in Aigupta gam a palai sawl in atung ah ahelta hi. Alohching ding hia? Hichibang hihmi asuakta ding hia? Thukhun hihse ngal in apawtkhe thou ding hia?"
Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; kumpipa, kumpipa dia bawlpa tenna ngei ah akichiamnate musit leh athukhunte bohsia a, amah kiang mahmah ah Babulon ah asi ding hi.
Mi tampi hihlup ding a mual pawngte leh kulhte abawl hun chiang un leng Pharaoh sepaihhon leh pawl thupi mahmah leng bangmah ahihsak thei kei ding uh.
Thukhun bohsia in kichiamna amusitta ngal ua; thu akichiam nung in hiai thil tengteng ahih nawn a, asuakta peuhmah kei ding hi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka kichiamna amusit a, ka thukhun abohsia a, kei ka hin bang in, ama tung ah ka bung ngeingei ding hi.
Len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang ah a-awk ding a, Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, huchi in abohsiatna, ka tung ngei a abohsiatnate ziak in amah ka sual ding.
Huan apawl tengteng a taikekte tengteng namsau in asi ding ua, a-omlaite kawlmong chih ah adalh ding uh; huan kei TOUPA'N ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sidar sang mahmah dawn ke'n ka la ding a, ka phut ding; azikpi pen aziknou ka khiak ding a, tang sang kidoh ah ka phut ding.
heading: Pathian Lametna Thuchiam

paite: Israel sanna tang ah ka phut ding a, hiangte ahong sel ding ua, ahong gah ding, sidar thupitak ahi ding; anuai ah tungleng vasa chi chih ateng ding ua, ahiang liimte ah a-om ding uh.

Huan gam sing tengteng in kei TOUPA'N sing sangte ka niamsak a, sing niamte ka sangsak a, sing hingte ka keusak a, sing keute ka hingphasak a, ka chi nalai hi,” achi hi. Kei TOUPA'N ka genta a, ka gen bang in ka hih ding hi.
